blocks.text: Zscaler recommends that you use the Authentication Service Admin Portal to configure primary and secondary external identity providers (IdPs). Authentication Service supports both SAML and OpenID configurations. Contact Zscaler Support to subscribe to Authentication Service.
You can configure identity providers (IdPs) to support single sign-on (SSO) for users. The SSO page allows you to:

blocks.item: Configure SAML for Microsoft Entra ID.
Configure SAML for Active Directory Federation Services.

blocks.text: IdPs provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Configure third-party IdPs using OpenID or SAML.
Leverage single authentication using the configured IdPs to allow users to sign in to the Zscaler ITDR Admin Portal.

blocks.text: On the IdP Providers page (Settings > Users & Roles > IdP Providers), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Add and configure SAML or OpenID IdPs to support SSO.
View a list of configured IdPs. For each IdP, you can view:
Name: The name of the IdP configuration.
Issuer: The URL of the IdP issuer.
Enabled: The status of the IdP configuration. The checkmark icon indicates that the IdP is enabled, and the X icon indicates that the IdP is disabled.
Edit or delete an SAML or OpenID IdP configuration.

blocks.text: If Authentication Service is enabled, you can't configure SSO using third-party IdPs in the ITDR Admin Portal. You must configure IdPs in the Authentication Service Admin Portal.
The existing SSO third-party IdPs are disabled.
To configure IdPs, click the Authentication Service link. You are redirected to the Authentication Service Admin Portal. To learn more, see About External Identity Providers.
